items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: What did you say he first started playing? Manning.

ctx.x: He had which, I couldn't see, he had that head to here? I couldn't see what you were pointing to.

No, his head, he had the brains and he had the ear. I see. He had the head, the brains, and the ear. What did you say he first started playing? Manning. And then he switched to... To guitar. And then he played what? Bass, string bass. And then? Trombone. Sliphorn. Sliphorn.
